description: This file contains helper methods for creating comments within integration tests for the Conduit application, specifically for test setup and verification purposes related to comments functionality.

classes.name: CommentHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods for creating and managing comments during integration testing.

methods.name: CreateComment
methods.description: Creates a comment on an article using the specified command, optionally creating a default user if userName is empty. Returns the created comment object.
